text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft won the Oaks. She shared the 
joy of becoming the Queen of the Oaks with 
her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cesario watched the scene with a bright, 
uplifted heart. Air Messiah, however, had 
a bitter look on her face as she hurried 
off the turf...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With winners and losers each holding their 
own emotions close to heart, the curtain 
fell on the Japanese Oaks.
